boundaries.name: primitive_u32_gate_lowering
boundaries.obligation: Prove that the exact pinned add_many_u32/sub_u32 field gates, wiring and zero connections imply each AddTrace/SubTrace limb equation with exact borrow convention. This module establishes no evaluator/compiler refinement.

boundaries.name: canonical_limb_range
boundaries.obligation: Connect checked allocation and primitive result wires to canonical natural 32-bit limbs; arithmetic over field residues alone is insufficient for the no-wrap theorem.

boundaries.name: fixed_shape_and_reverse_zip
boundaries.obligation: Refine Rust arrays, target identities, iter().rev().zip(), output ordering and imported accessors to the lists and expanded builder operations.

boundaries.name: native_and_other_helpers_pending
boundaries.obligation: Translate native u64/i64 arithmetic, shifts/casts, panic behavior, conversions/serialization, target comparison and shared traits before claiming the whole U256 implementation or native-target agreement.
